name: Citizenship by Option (Children of Argentine Natives Born Abroad)

qualifying_event.description: Children of native-born Argentine citizens who were themselves born abroad may opt for Argentine citizenship of origin.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Birth certificate; parent's proof of native Argentine citizenship (by birth, not naturalization); application before a competent civil-registry or consular authority.

requirement_groups.name: Child of a native-born Argentine parent

requirements.blocker_text: 'Los hijos de Argentinos nativos, que habiendo nacido en pais estranjero optaren por la ciudadanía de origen' -- a person born abroad to a native-born Argentine parent may formally opt for citizenship of origin (Ley 346, Article 1(2)).

evidence_required.document: Parent's proof of native (jus soli) Argentine citizenship

sources.title: República Argentina -- Ley 346 de Ciudadanía y Naturalización (texto actualizado), Artículo 1(2): citizenship by option for children of native-born Argentine citizens born abroad

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Argentina). The extracted text specifies 'Argentinos NATIVOS' (native-born Argentines) as the qualifying parent -- read narrowly, this suggests the option route may not extend to children of NATURALIZED or by-option Argentine citizens born abroad, only to children of those who were themselves born Argentine (jus soli or a prior generation's option). This one-generation-only reading was not independently cross-confirmed against a second tier-1 source in this pass and is flagged as an interpretive judgment call, consistent with how similar one-generation-cap questions were handled for other countries in this dataset (e.g. Trinidad and Tobago's citizenship by descent). This route requires no residence in Argentina at all, unlike ar_naturalisation.json and ar_citizenship_by_investment.json.
